_notes.title: Optional. The name at the top of the page. Left out, it reads Countdown Wall.
_notes.theme: celebration (black, tiles in each event's full color, a glow under the top countdown), calm (bone paper, tiles in soft tints, no glow), or auto (calm on a light device, celebration on a dark one).
_notes.events: Everything being counted down to. The nearest one fills the top of the page; the rest are tiles by date; past ones count up as since tiles.
_notes.events[].id: A short name for the event in lowercase letters, digits, and dashes, like kyoto-trip. Each id is used once.
_notes.events[].title: What the event is called on its tile.
_notes.events[].date: When it is: a date and time like 2026-11-13T07:40 (local time), or a date alone like 2026-11-26 for an all-day event, which lasts until 23:59 that day. Add Z or an offset like +09:00 for a time somewhere else.
_notes.events[].start: Optional. When the wait began; the progress bar on the tile runs from here to the date. Left out, the bar covers the year before the date.
_notes.events[].color: Optional. A hex color like #ff5a24, or one of tangerine, rose, gold, violet, sky, cobalt, coral, teal, lime, amber, sage, magenta. Left out, events take those colors in turn.
_notes.events[].icon: Optional. One of baby, briefcase, cake, calendar, flag, gift, graduation-cap, guitar, heart, house, key-round, leaf, mountain, music, party-popper, pen-line, plane, rocket, sparkles, sprout, star, sun, tent, ticket, trophy.
_notes.events[].image: Optional. A picture file beside this inputs file, shown behind the event in full screen. kyoto-maples.svg is a sample picture that ships with the app.
_notes.events[].repeat: Optional. yearly for a birthday or a holiday: once it passes, it counts down to the same day next year.
